# 2 Baruch Chapter 73 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**73:1** "And it shall come to pass, when he has brought low everything that is in the world and has sat down in peace forever on the throne of his kingdom, that joy will then be revealed, and rest will appear."

**73:2** "And then healing will descend in dew, and disease will depart, and anxiety and anguish and lamentation will pass away from among men, and gladness will proceed throughout the whole earth."

**73:3** "And no one will die untimely, and no adversity will suddenly befall anyone."

**73:4** "Judgments and abusings and contentions and revenges, and blood and passions and envy and hatred, and all such things, will go into condemnation, for it is these things that have filled this world with evils."

**73:5** "And wild beasts will come from the forest and minister unto men, and asps and dragons will come forth from their holes to submit themselves to a little child."

**73:6** "And women will no longer then have pain when they bear, nor will they suffer torment when they yield the fruits of the womb."

**73:7** "And it shall come to pass in those days that the reapers will not grow weary, nor will those who build be toilworn; for the works will of themselves speedily advance together with those who do them in all blessings."

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
